big: Out of every ₹100 in the defence budget, only about ₹28 buys new equipment. Another ₹26 pays serving staff and ₹22 pays pensions. Reading the split tells you who really gets the money.

lines: Is the budget mostly for new weapons?
About 28% is capital. Pay is about 26%, pensions about 22%, and upkeep about 20%. In FY20, pay and pensions took over 56%, so the capital share has improved since.
